promotion_archive_cache_removed_bytes.verdict: The justification was incomplete. The transport policy does call the local materialization an ignorable cache, but two consumers required it to be present, so the deletion turned two green gates red.
promotion_archive_cache_removed_bytes.resolution: Owner chose to resolve the contradiction rather than re-download. dialect-migration-selftest is green again through a Git-history fallback for git-tracked historical evidence. r6-g6-registered-seal-check stays red by design: it re-runs an isolated offline verifier from inside the archive, and four archives (3.1 GB) would have to be materialized for it.

comment_translation.scope: Every C source, header and scripts/equivalence-main.c is done; src/ and scripts/ hold zero German comment lines.

product_delta_proof.claim: The block's central promise is zero product delta, yet phase H-D changed 21 C sources and headers.
product_delta_proof.method: Every changed .c file was preprocessed with the actual product compiler (tools/llvm-mos/bin/mos-mega65-clang -E -P) at bc11ff7c~1 and at HEAD, and the token streams byte-compared. -P suppresses line markers, so a changed line count cannot mask a real difference.
product_delta_proof.result: 13 of 13 identical, 0 divergent, 0 skipped. The 12 changed headers are covered transitively as includes of those files.
product_delta_proof.line_dependent_semantics: Checked separately: none of the changed product sources uses __LINE__ or assert(). src/vm_embed.c has a _Static_assert, which is compile-time only.
product_delta_proof.verdict: An identical token stream cannot yield different code generation, so the comment translation carries zero product delta by construction, not by assertion.

h_c3_elf_truth.correction: The reviewer first reported 'one private ELF view survives'. That was wrong: the grep used was too narrow. The real count of tools/host-lisp/*.py files that invoke llvm-nm, llvm-readelf or llvm-size without ever using shared ElfTruth is 58.
h_c3_elf_truth.finding: c2-elf-truth-migration reported 'private=0', which reads as a statement about the whole tree. It is not: the migration rule governs six named gate consumers only, and probes are outside it. The gate said more than it proved -- this project's recurring failure family.
h_c3_elf_truth.resolution: The 58 ungoverned probes are pinned by name in config/c2-elf-truth-contract.json (ungoverned_column_parsers_2026_07_30). They are not rewritten or moved -- they are unreachable from the build and several are named in immutable receipts. The gate now verifies the pin and its output states the scope: 'private-in-governed=0 ungoverned-probes-pinned=58 present=58'. A new hand-rolled column parser must either join the governed consumers or move the pin deliberately.
h_c3_elf_truth.teeth: mutations 4 -> 5. The new mutation drops a file from the pin and requires the gate to reject the resulting unpinned parser rather than absorbing it silently.

tool_defect_found.defect: It rebinds more receipts than the check requires. Run after an unrelated source change, it also rebound three architecture-block receipts whose staleness had nothing to do with that change -- including one recording an older lib/lcc.lisp than the committed tree. That quietly absorbs someone else's in-flight drift into a housekeeping commit.
tool_defect_found.action_taken: The three gratuitous rebindings were reverted; the gate passes without them. Not fixed here -- reported so the --write path can be narrowed to what the check actually demands.
